channel.title: council-brief: Blue Ridge and Fannin County meetings
channel.description: New summaries of local government meetings in Blue Ridge and Fannin County, Georgia.

item.title: City Council Workshop, November 10, 2026
item.description: The council reviewed a comprehensive pay plan based on GMA resources, discussed utility extension policies to gain negotiation leverage with the county, addressed open records and the Blue Ridge on Ice event contract, and heard public comments on homelessness. A speaker proposed a cooperative harm-reduction approach for long-term homelessness solutions involving established locations around town. Votes: Extend the time for discussion: result unclear from the recording.

item.title: Planning Commission, November 3, 2026
item.description: The Planning Commission reviewed two rezoning requests and a hotel development proposal, including site analysis, utility plans, and stormwater management requirements. Commissioners discussed engineering challenges on Shamrock Road, parking codes, and long-range planning goals while residents raised concerns about traffic, growth controls, and the potential for future development without the hotel project. Votes: Approved the minutes and agenda. Rezone the property to C2: result unclear from the recording. Rezone the property to Central Business District (CBD): died for lack of a second. Rezone partial land to C2 with staff conditions: passed (3-1). Approve a conditional use permit for the hotel: failed (3-2).
